- **Technical Capabilities:** Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, React, Vite, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, GSAP.

## Featured Portfolio Projects
1. **NoBroker Packers & Movers UX Redesign:** Comprehensive user experience overhaul of the relocation and logistics booking platform to increase user trust and streamline order flow.
2. **InkScale E-commerce Mobile App:** High-converting mobile shopping UI/UX built with intuitive filtering, rapid checkout, and clean typography.
3. **Seed to Soul Resort Experience:** Luxury hospitality booking platform with rich visual design, immersive layout, and seamless room reservation flow.
4. **Quash Laundry Service App:** On-demand laundry mobile application designed for intuitive order scheduling and real-time status tracking.
5. **Hozatra Enterprise Web UI:** B2B corporate identity and interactive web portal design for enterprise clients.
